name: Dispatching Parallel Agents
description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies — dispatch them to parallel agents for concurrent execution.

commands.description: Dispatch independent tasks to parallel agents
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the dispatching-parallel-agents skill: identify the independent tasks, write self-contained briefs for each agent (goal, context, deliverable, report format), dispatch concurrently, then collect and integrate results.
